question: Through what grave transgression was the state of Bhairava attained by the speaker?
premises: Sins committed as Brahman-murder are involved.
These sins are attributed to the speaker.
The state of Bhairava was attained by the speaker.
inference: The speaker attained Bhairava-hood through sins committed as Brahman-murder.
uncertainties: The internal compound structure of brahmahatyākṛtaiḥ may be parsed as a tatpuruṣa or as a descriptive compound.
plain_english: Through sins committed as the murder of a Brahman, I attained the state of Bhairava.
